## BUSINESS CONTEXT & USER FLOW
"This application is designed to support the digitalization of the guest attendance registration process for the MAPSI Elementary School Competition XXVII at the Kedungtuban District level in 2026. The system replaces the manual paper-based attendance process with a QR Code-based registration system that is faster, more organized, accurate, and easier for the committee to manage.

Each invited guest has identity information and a unique QR Code that can be included on printed invitations or sent via WhatsApp. Upon arrival at the event venue, the committee scans the QR Code using a mobile phone, tablet, or laptop camera. The system then automatically verifies the guest and records the guest’s name, institution or school, position, arrival date, arrival time, and attendance status in real time.

The system must prevent duplicate attendance records. If the same QR Code is scanned again, the application displays a notification indicating that the guest has already registered, along with the previous attendance time. Alternatively, a name search feature and manual check-in option are available to handle situations where guests forget to bring their invitations, their QR Codes cannot be scanned, their devices experience problems, or they attend as representatives.

The admin dashboard is used by the committee to monitor the total number of invited guests, the number of guests who have arrived, the number of guests who have not yet arrived, and the latest arrival list in real time. After the event, attendance data can be summarized and printed in PDF format for accountability reports, event reports, documentation, and committee archives.

The application is expected to have a simple, formal, modern, responsive, and user-friendly interface for the committee. The design may be adapted to the identity of the MAPSI Elementary School Competition XXVII at the Kedungtuban District level in 2026 by using the event logo, event name, and appropriate colors. The system should also be reusable for future MAPSI events or similar activities by simply updating the guest data and event information."
